senior.routing_note: Senior adjudication completed for Stage 1; exclusion recommended based on title/abstract evidence alone.
senior.short_summary: Audio-domain supervised prediction/regression study (geographical origin of music) with no evidence in title/abstract of preference-based learning signals or RL; exclude at Stage 1.
senior.disagreement_resolution: Juniors agreed on most criteria but conflicted on I2_RATINGS_TO_PREFERENCE (junior_nano: NO, junior_mini: UNCLEAR) and on final decision. I resolved I2 as NO because the abstract contains no mention of numeric ratings or conversion to comparative preference signals. Given I1, I2, and I3 are all NO, the paper lacks the required preference-learning signals and thus is excluded. The final decision follows the mini review's exclusion outcome while adopting the nano review's explicit NO for I2; hence a hybrid adjudication.
